name: shadow-walker
description: A persistent, human-reviewed toolkit for situated latent-space cartography

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build && vite build --config vite.dashboard.config.ts && node scripts/build-site.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:core: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/core.test.ts tests/context.test.ts tests/cartography.test.ts tests/flight-lines.test.ts tests/waypoints.test.ts tests/traversals.test.ts tests/gestures.test.ts tests/postgres-contract.test.ts tests/browser-security.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
